notes: Most assertions pass in both configurations (non-discriminating): Opus already renders competent 1080x1350 PNGs and gets facts right without the skill. The only discriminating check was minimum text size (baseline RERA had 55 runs under 24px).

Qualitative difference is larger than the pass rate shows: with-skill runs produced one ownable concept each (receipt 'speaker confirmed', ledger checkbox progression, 'named after the heat') plus a brief with alternates, a brand kit and phone/grid previews.

Weak spot in with-skill output: 'prefer type-led' made two runs too sparse. RERA check slides have an empty middle band; the cafe carousel never shows the product, while the baseline drew illustrated bottles and portal mock-ups that make the content concrete.
Cost: with-skill runs took about 1.5-2.7x the time and 1.3-1.5x the tokens (more reading plus 2-3 render/QA loops).
